title: Changes to the Standing Draft Instruction on an Auto Loan and the Rate That Follows
content:
Where a borrower on a loan of the Auto Loans line puts a standing instruction to draft the installment in place, or withdraws one, the loan's record of that instruction changes and the rate the loan carries is restated on the footing the instruction leaves.

**The rate restated on the loan is fixed only after every installment already due stands satisfied on the loan's records.** Where the loan's records still show an installment whose due date has passed and which is not satisfied, the rate to be restated is not yet fixed.

## The capability

`set_loan_autopay_8313b066` is the borrower's own tool for setting or withdrawing the standing instruction that drafts their auto loan installment from a checking account, and for putting the loan's rate on the footing that instruction leaves. The instruction on the loan is set to what is passed: where it is put in place the named checking account is recorded as the account the installment is drafted from, and where it is withdrawn the loan carries no drafting account at all and the installment must be paid some other way. The loan's annual percentage rate is rewritten to the figure passed, and the reductions recorded against the rate are rewritten to the value passed, so the borrower sees the new rate on the loan straight away.

## How it is invoked

The tool is hidden and belongs to the borrower. The agent unlocks `set_loan_autopay_8313b066` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | The reference number of the borrower's auto loan whose drafting instruction is being set; the servicing agent reads it from the loan record and hands it over with the tool | Id |
| `autopay_source_account_id` | The reference number of the Piedmont Crescent checking account the installment is drafted from, or was drafted from up to now; the servicing agent reads it from the checking account lookup and hands it over | Id |
| `autopay_enrolled` | Whether the loan is to carry a standing drafting instruction after this call | Enum |
| `restated_apr` | The annual percentage rate the loan is to carry from now on | Percent with 2 decimal places, passed already rounded |
| `rate_discounts` | Which reductions the restated rate is recorded as carrying | Enum |

The complete set of values `autopay_enrolled` takes: `true`, where the installment is to be drafted automatically from the checking account named above on each due date; and `false`, where no automatic draft is to stand on the loan and the installment is to be paid by some other means.

The complete set of values `rate_discounts` takes: `none`, where the rate carries no reduction at all; `autopay`, where the rate carries only the reduction earned by the standing drafting instruction; `relationship`, where the rate carries only the reduction earned by the qualifying checking relationship held at funding; and `autopay_and_relationship`, where the rate carries both of those reductions together.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the loan reference number, whether a standing drafting instruction now stands on it and against which checking account, the annual percentage rate now recorded as a percent to two decimals, and the reductions recorded against it. Receiving that sentence means the loan record carries the new instruction and the new rate.
